title: Music Row Haven | Private Hot Tub + Near Broadway
description:
Saddle up for the ultimate Music City getaway! Livin' Luxe on Music Row blends bold, colorful decor inspired by country music's Queens with everything groups need: 4 private king suites (each with en-suite bath), spacious gathering areas, and a rooftop hot tub with skyline views. Walk to dining, shops, and legendary recording studios, or rideshare minutes to Broadway, The Gulch, Vanderbilt & 12 South. 2 assigned parking spots.

The space
Livin' Luxe on Music Row is built for groups who want it all in one place – 4 private king suites, a wide-open third floor made for cooking, hanging out, and getting ready together, & a private rooftop hot tub with city views. The neon signs and country music details make it clear exactly what city you're in.

You're one minute walk from legendary recording studios and a couple blocks from coffee, dinner, and boutique shopping. Plus, just a 5–10 minute rideshare to ALL of Nashville's hotspots, including Broadway, The Gulch, Vanderbilt, 12 South, Midtown, Hillsboro Village, and Belmont.  Start your morning at yoga or pilates studio, grab local coffee next door, and tour RCA Studio B, all with-in walking distance. Our local property manager is always on-hand for reservations, recommendations, and anything else you need.

HOME FEATURES:
✦ 4 Private King Suites, Each with En-Suite Bath
✦ Rooftop Hot Tub Deck with Lounge Seating & Skyline Views
✦ Open-Concept Third Floor Built for Groups
✦ Fully Stocked Chef's Kitchen
✦ 2 Private Parking Spaces
✦ Custom Neon Signs & Nashville-Inspired Design
✦ Smart TVs, Games, Cards & a Record Player🎶
✦ Coffee Bar with Local Coffee, Creamer, and Sugar 

◇ THE LAYOUT ◇
4 Bedrooms | 4.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 12
4 King Beds, 2 Hotel-Style Twin Rollaways, 1 Queen Sleeper Sofa

FIRST & SECOND FLOORS — 4 King Suites, Two Per Floor, Each Private En-Suite

Every suite: Smart TV & bedside charging, dedicated workspace, blackout curtains, closet with luggage rack & full-length mirror, walk-in shower with LED mirror & stocked bathroom 

 THIRD FLOOR — Kitchen & Dining, Living Room, Half Bath, Rooftop Deck with Private Hot Tub (serviced before every stay). 
Fully retractable glass doors merge it all into one indoor-outdoor space!

THE EXTRAS:
✔ Comfortable Memory Foam Mattresses
✔ Washer & Dryer, Steamer & Iron
✔ Fully Stocked Essentials (paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dish soap, dishwasher pods & laundry detergent)
✔ Pro-Cleaned Linens & Extra Pillows
✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi
✔ Coffee, Creamers, Sugars & Light Snacks
✔ No Checkout Chores — Just Lock Up & Enjoy Your Last Day
✔ Complimentary  Early Check-In When Available
✔ Locally Owned and Operated

Consistent 5-star stays start with the details — and we've thought through all of them. Whether it's a celebration, a family reunion, or just a weekend soaking up Music City, we'd love to host you at Livin' Luxe on Music Row. 🤠

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire home. The two parking spots can accommodate two mid-sized vehicles (note: they may not fit larger trucks or SUVs, but there is tons of FREE street parking by house). Check-in is seamless with a smart lock, and we’re available 24/7 should you need anything during your stay.

Other things to note
Please read before booking! This home is truly special — a lot of time, care, and investment has gone into creating a space we love. We welcome respectful guests who will treat both the property and our neighbors with care. 

- No smoking or pets. 
- No glitter or confetti. No decorations on walls with wallpaper. We are happy to connect you with professional decorators! 
- Leave the home in good condition. Excessive mess or damage may result in charges.
- All guests agree to follow hot tub guidelines. (SEE BELOW)

*Hot Tub Guidelines*
To keep the hot tub in top condition and avoid malfunction, please agree to the following before booking:
- Always keep the lid on when not in use
- Maintain temperature between 96-98°F. 
- Do not turn off the breaker at any time.
Failure to follow these rules may result in an additional fee.

Hot Tub Servicing Notes – Our hot tub is professionally serviced before every stay. For long stays, we will reach out to arrange an extra cleaning as needed.

-------------------
Want to curate your Nashville experience? We do all the work for you so you can fully immerse yourself in Vacation Mode! Choose from our handful of highly utilized add-ons. Here are some of our Guest Favorites:

- Complimentary Fill-the-Fridge
- Luggage Storage
- Personalized Itinerary Planning
- Personal Chef Services
- Charcuterie Board Delivery
- Celebration Packages such as Gourmet Cake Delivery
- Discounts with local partners such as Joyride Party Buses and Golf Carts
- And much more...

I truly hope your time here in our wonderful city is special.  There's something here for everyone!  Please take this time to unwind, enjoy yourself and explore everything Nashville has to offer!

Thank you for staying in my unique little piece of history here in the city.  We've tried to make our home cozy and comfortable yet stylish and fun at the same time.  We hope you enjoy it as much as we do! 

Cheers,

Dave
